description: Source code for deployment tools and classes related to remote connection, file transfer, packaging, and deployment of modules in a multiap_sw environment.

classes.name: mapconnect
classes.description: Handles SSH and SFTP connections to a remote proxy target, including uploading files and executing commands.

classes.name: mapcopy
classes.description: Facilitates copying files to a target using configuration loaded from a YAML file.

classes.name: mapdeploy
classes.description: Manages packaging, archiving, and deploying modules to a target environment, including creating tar.gz archives and copying deployment scripts.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for classes, initializes configurations and connections.

methods.name: __connect__
methods.description: Establishes SSH and SFTP connections to the proxy.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes commands on the remote target via SSH.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads files to the remote target via SFTP and executes remote commands to set permissions.

methods.name: configure_parser
methods.description: Configures command-line argument parser for the respective command.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Packages module directories into a tar.gz archive for deployment.
